definition: The mass per unit volume of a material, $\rho = \frac{m}{V}$, measured in g/cm³ or kg/m³ ($1\ \text{g/cm}^3 = 1000\ \text{kg/m}^3$).

A way to find the volume of an irregular solid that sinks: its volume equals the rise in the water level in a measuring cylinder when the solid is completely under water, or the volume of water that overflows from a full displacement can.
